business_problem: Garanti BBVA wanted customers to complete banking tasks conversationally inside digital channels, with more personalized support and less reliance on call centers or branches for routine requests and service workflows.
solution_summary: Garanti BBVA rebuilt Ugi from a rules-based chatbot into an LLM-based AI infrastructure embedded in the bank's mobile app. Customer requests enter through the mobile app as text or voice, where Ugi acts as the conversational layer for day-to-day banking. The LLM-based AI infrastructure interprets natural-language intent, understands context, and generates personalized responses or next actions instead of relying only on predefined questions. To fulfill requests, Ugi is integrated with banking systems that expose product catalogs, customer profile information, and transaction data, allowing it to answer account questions, explain activity, and initiate end-to-end service workflows such as temporary limit increases or ATM issue resolution. The same architecture also supports proactive notifications and digital guidance, extending Ugi from FAQ-style support into a transaction-capable banking assistant.

solution_components.name: Ugi
solution_components.role: The assistant handles conversational banking, guides users to digital services, and executes or initiates end-to-end banking workflows.

solution_components.name: LLM-based AI infrastructure
solution_components.role: This AI layer replaced the rules-based bot so Ugi can understand context, interpret natural-language requests, and generate personalized solutions.

solution_components.name: mobile app
solution_components.role: The bank's app is the delivery channel where customers interact with Ugi through text and voice.

data_flow: Customers submit text or voice requests in the mobile app, where Ugi passes them to the LLM-based AI infrastructure for intent and context understanding. Ugi then uses integrations with banking systems, product catalogs, customer profile information, and transaction data to return answers, trigger banking transactions, or initiate service-resolution workflows, while the same setup also drives proactive instant notifications.
business_outcome: Ugi has become a high-volume self-service banking assistant that delivers more personalized customer support, handles hundreds of banking transactions digitally, and proactively guides users instead of forcing them to rely on human-assisted channels.
